descriptions.job-1jrglrp:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our Toronto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving.

BitGo is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build and evolve the ledger systems behind our clients' balances, trading positions, and financial reporting. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering and accounting — designing the double-entry ledger primitives that other engineering teams build on, and making sure new products are designed with financial correctness in mind from day one rather than retrofitted after launch.

This is a rare role for someone who genuinely understands accounting fundamentals and wants to apply that knowledge to hard distributed-systems problems in a live financial platform.

What You'll Do

  • Design and extend our core ledger — accounts, postings, and the account-type/ledger structures that every financial product is built on.
  • Own the chart-of-accounts and reporting surface that connects engineering data to financial statements and downstream reporting.
  • Work across the boundary between on-chain data and off-chain books: balance verification, reconciliation, and proof-of-reserve style mechanisms.
  • Partner with engineering teams early in the design process to make sure new features correctly model legal entity ownership, ledger placement, pricing, and reconciliation paths — before they ship, not after.
  • Design data models that can absorb new financial products (margin, lending, staking, tokenized assets, and more) cleanly, without repeated painful migrations.

What We're Looking For

  • Real, working knowledge of accounting fundamentals: double-entry bookkeeping, chart-of-accounts design, financial statements (P&L, balance sheet), and what reconciliation and audit actually require in practice.
  • 5+ years of backend software engineering experience, with a track record of owning data-model design for systems where correctness is the product, not just uptime.
  • Strong instincts for extensible system design — schemas and APIs that can grow with new requirements instead of requiring repeated rework.
  • Comfort reading and critiquing technical designs across multiple systems, not just writing your own.
  • Strong cross-functional communication — you'll work directly with Finance, Data Engineering, and Product on shared designs.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in crypto or blockchain infrastructure — on-chain balance models, custody, or wallet architecture.
  • Experience with event-driven or Kafka-based service architectures.
  • Prior experience in an embedded "accounting architecture" or financial-systems design-review role at a fintech or crypto company.

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

Benefits may vary based on location.

Pay Transparency Notice:

Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $180,000 and $220,000 CAD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.
descriptions.job-0borur9:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Stripe, you'll support some of the region's largest and most innovative companies across various industries. You'll help power Stripe's growth engine by partnering closely with the Demand Generation and Account Executive teams to qualify leads and build a high-quality sales pipeline. You thrive on engaging with prospects, uncovering their needs, and identifying high-value opportunities. You're skilled at navigating early-stage sales conversations and energized by both learning new products and articulating their value in complex scenarios.

You also enjoy building—whether it's improving the demand generation and sales processes, sharpening how we communicate Stripe's value, or creating tools and assets that help the team scale. If you're hungry, curious, persistent, and a strong team player, we'd love to hear from you.

For the first months, you'll be part of the Sales Development Associate program, which is designed to accelerate your onboarding and ramp to full productivity as an SDR. This intensive program is built to help you quickly build and develop skills required to be successful in this role. Upon completion, you'll continue learning and growing in your career as part of Stripe's Sales Development Academy. These programs are endorsed and supported by sales leaders as an important part of investing in our people.

We take a data-driven, problem-solving approach to sales development, and look for someone who is confident in both prospecting to customers and in helping design our strategy.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Research and create outreach materials for high-value prospects, in partnership with SDRs and AEs
  • Follow up with Marketing-generated leads to qualify as sales opportunities. Move solid leads through the funnel connecting them to a salesperson, and arranging meetings
  • Execute outbound sales plays created by Marketing
  • Initiate contact with potential customers through cold-calling or responding to inquiries generated from Marketing
  • Develop relationships with prospects to uncover needs through effective questioning to qualify interest and viability to prepare hand-off to sales
  • Follow up with potential customers who expressed interest but did not initially result in a sales opportunity
  • Effectively work through lead list meeting and exceeding service-level agreements, consistently update activity and contact information within the CRM system, and support weekly reporting efforts
  • Collaborate and provide feedback and insights to Marketing to help improve targeting and messaging
  • Prospect into enterprises of all sizes across the APAC region using a variety of tools and outreach methods

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • A track record of top performance or prior success in academic, extracurricular, or professional endeavors
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to clearly articulate complex topics
  • Self-starter who is highly motivated and able to operate effectively and autonomously in a hyper-growth environment
  • This role requires in-office participation three (3) days per week in our Sydney office.

Preferred qualifications

  • Professional experience in a sales, customer service, or fast-paced professional environment

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
descriptions.job-1b78cmt:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Workplace team’s mission is to create and support work environments that are welcoming, comfortable, and intuitive. These spaces are designed to promote collaboration, well-being, and productivity while adhering to the rigorous safety, security, and confidentiality standards required of a financial services company.

The Workplace Experience team comprises operations, hospitality-focused and financially responsible professionals who directly shape the daily experiences of Stripes, visitors, and candidates across 20+ global office locations. This geographically dispersed team oversees facilities management, daily operations, and programs, including a culinary team dedicated to preparing nutritious meals.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a strategic leader and experienced workplace manager with a high EQ who's enthusiastic about, and has a driving need to deliver, the best possible workplace experience for Stripes. You will be a key member of our Experience team and responsible for ensuring that workplace operations, experiences, facilities, and programs run smoothly at our Bengaluru office. As a business partner, you have a deep understanding of the needs, experiences, and day-to-day realities of Stripes at your location and build strong relationships not only with site leads but also with cross-functional partners across the organization.

This role requires a high level of expertise and operational oversight—from understanding how the building functions top to bottom to governance of contractor team performance and ensuring financial accountability. Bengaluru is a complex site with a significant employee transportation program, and you will be accountable for the reliability, service quality, and continuous improvement of these operations. You will work in close strategic partnership with our integrated facilities management partner, establishing clear expectations, maintaining strong governance, addressing performance gaps, and ensuring services meet Stripe’s operational and workplace experience standards.

You will also play a critical role in managing operational incidents and disruptions. This requires remaining calm under pressure, bringing structure to ambiguity, coordinating the appropriate internal and external partners, communicating clearly with stakeholders, and translating lessons from incidents into durable operational improvements.

A key part of the role is anticipating the needs of the business by understanding both the site and the broader context of company growth. You will gather and synthesize feedback from multiple sources to ensure the workplace strategy is informed by real insights from the ground. While enterprise workplace strategy is developed centrally, you are expected to bring informed recommendations based on local business needs and operational insight, and to own successful implementation and adoption at your site. You will develop site-level plans, surface material risks early, and provide leaders with clear recommendations and trade-offs rather than simply escalating problems.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee workplace operations at your site(s), providing direction on all workplace services, including building operations, front of house, shipping & receiving, events support, and employee health and safety.
  • Make sound, independent operational decisions by balancing business impact, risk, cost, and employee experience, seeking alignment when decisions create broader organizational impact or precedent.
  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of workplace services professionals, providing direction, coaching, and performance management to drive team excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, including senior leadership, department heads, and cross-functional teams.
  • Develop a strong rapport with locally assigned Stripes.
  • Own operational performance for your site by monitoring service levels and utilization, identifying trends, resolving root causes, and driving continuous improvement across workplace operations.
  • Proactively anticipate business needs by understanding both local context and company priorities.
  • Develop thoughtful, data-informed recommendations that help shape workplace programs and experiences while maintaining alignment with global standards.
  • Hold workplace partners and service providers accountable for performance, ensuring contractual obligations, service levels, and operational standards are consistently achieved while driving continuous improvement.
  • Work closely with our Finance & Strategy partner and IFM partner to develop and oversee the opex budget for all facilities, opex, fixed assets and events of the Bengaluru office.
  • Work closely with the local site leadership team to activate the office by creating engagement, connection, and an inclusive environment.
  • Craft relevant communications and documentation regarding Workplace policies and programs for Stripes.
  • Ensure consistent execution of global workplace programs, standards, and policies at your site,  as developed by our Food, Space Planning, and Programs teams, adapting implementation to local operational requirements while maintaining alignment with enterprise objectives.
  • Support the Workplace team's goals by taking on ad hoc tasks and projects as they arise.

Who you are

Minimum requirements:

  • 7 years of experience in workplace/hospitality management in a fast-paced environment with a strong customer service orientation and an understanding of operational best practices
  • Strong demonstrated ability in facilities management, vendor, and budget management
  • Strength in building relationships with key internal partners to ensure efficiency and understanding on cross-functional projects
  • Experience managing a team focused on customer service, hospitality, and operations, with the ability and desire to develop and coach your team
  • Ability to synthesize operational data, stakeholder feedback, and business context into clear recommendations that support sound decision making.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
  • An innovative mindset with the ability to drive exceptional workplace services and operational improvements

Preferred qualifications:

  • Proficiency in Google Suite, Slack and Jira
  • A clear willingness to take a hands-on approach and dive into the details
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional partners and translate enterprise strategy into effective local execution.
  • Ability to operate independently, digging into problems to understand the root cause and delivering scalable solutions
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced workplace with rapidly changing priorities
  • Adept at using and experimenting with provided AI tools for things like, identifying practical opportunities to automate routine work, generate operational insights from workplace data, and improve the experience for employees and visitors.
  • An innovative mindset with the ability to drive exceptional workplace services and operational improvements
descriptions.job-1s3259x:
The Opportunity

If you enjoy applying your quantitative and ML skills to real-world problems, coding production-quality analysis and tools, and working in a fast-paced environment with immediate and tangible feedback, our Summer Internship Program is ideal for you.

At Brevan Howard, we build systematic and discretionary investment processes that rely on rigorous analysis of a vast universe of data, such as asset prices, macroeconomic indicators, news, sell-side research, and trading signals.

Transforming this data into actionable insights is central to how we win, and we’re looking to find the next generation of portfolio managers and quants through our internship program—people who are eager to push the frontier of research and engineering in global macro investing.

What you will do

You will work directly with our front-office personnel to provide immediate impact on a range of projects:

  • Build pipelines to extract and analyse data, develop models and trading signals, and support decision-making of Portfolio Managers.

  • Integrate AI into analytical systems as well as building new AI-powered tools using the latest LLMs and agent workflows.

  • Contribute to our core analytics library, which is leveraged by Quants and PMs across the firm for research, trading and risk management.

How we will support you

Our Internship Program starts with one-week in-depth training to prepare interns for the desk. This covers a range of topics relevant for financial markets, including macroeconomics, traditional assets (fixed income, currencies, equity markets, and commodities), digital assets, trading strategies, risk management, and the latest AI tools and LLMs.

Additionally, you will benefit from key talks, a mentor program, social events and engagements with some of the most respected and talented individuals in their field. 

Why take this opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to gain insight into one of the world’s leading firms operating at the forefront of macro trading. At Brevan Howard, we believe the future of investing lies at the intersection of deep domain expertise and cutting-edge technology. As our industry is being reshaped by AI and automation, you’ll see first-hand how LLMs, retrieval, and agent-like systems are being used in the front-office environment at one of the world’s premier macro hedge funds – where correctness, robustness and speed matter.

Top performing interns are considered for our Graduate Program the following year and longer-term paths include roles as analyst, quant, and portfolio manager.

The Requirements

  • A penultimate year undergraduate or master's student in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Quantitative or a STEM-related field.

  • Solid coding skills.

  • A demonstrated interest in ML/AI and the ability to explain fundamental concepts.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Finance/trading knowledge is a bonus but not a requirement: we care more about your ability to learn quickly, reason from data, solve problems, and build quality code.
descriptions.job-0np8ed1:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood's International team owns the full international product experience, bringing investing, trading, and crypto to customers in the EU, UK, Canada, Singapore, and beyond. 

As a Product Designer, you'll help shape how customers around the world experience our products for the first time. You'll design onboarding, trading, and money movement experiences that hold up across currencies, languages, and regulatory environments, while staying true to the craft and clarity Robinhood is known for.

Design at Robinhood is AI-first. This role is for someone who already uses AI as a core part of how they think, explore, and execute.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

  • Design key features such as onboarding, trading, crypto, and money movement for one or more of Robinhood's international markets.
  • Partner with product, engineering, legal, and compliance to navigate market-specific nuances without compromising a cohesive, high-quality experience.
  • Bring clarity to complexity by simplifying cross-border and multi-currency concepts into interfaces that feel simple and local.
  • Use AI to explore ideas, catch edge cases, and prototype quickly, while you drive the quality and direction.
  • Set direction and keep projects moving in markets with little existing precedent.

What you bring

  • 3+ years of product design experience and a strong portfolio showing end-to-end ownership of complex consumer products.
  • Regular use of AI in your design process.
  • Interest in global markets and cross-border financial products.
  • Experience working with legal, compliance, and cross-functional partners in a regulated environment.
  • Strong systems thinking, balancing consistency with Robinhood's core product against local market needs.
  • A bias for action: able to find the next step and move forward through ambiguity.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Best in class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. About the team

The Stripe EMEA Marketing team is a dynamic and rapidly growing group dedicated to transforming customers into enthusiastic advocates for Stripe. Collaborating closely with sales, we focus on accelerating the path to purchase and enhancing product adoption among our user base. Our regional marketing efforts involve crafting and executing tailored marketing plans that resonate with local audiences, as well as spearheading our most significant conferences and sponsorships that drive go-to-market (GTM) success and business growth. Join us and be part of a culture that celebrates teamwork, innovates boldly, and makes a meaningful impact.

What you’ll do

You’ll be part of the EMEA Marketing team and be able to craft our enterprise and industry marketing strategy for the UK market while developing a strong trusted relationship working hand-in-hand with sales teams to drive successful user outcomes. The UK Enterprise Marketing Manager will define and execute field marketing program activations for integrated campaigns, targeted regional campaigns aligned to sales priorities, mid-funnel programs to accelerate leads and pipeline, high-tough programs, and Account Based Marketing. The ideal candidate is data-driven, and has an unbridled passion for working hand-in-hand with sales teams to drive successful user outcomes. As a key member of the EMEA Marketing team, this is a great opportunity to build and have an impact on the business.

Responsibilities

  • Craft enterprise marketing strategy and execute field marketing programs across enterprise customer segments (established enterprises, digital native businesses, software platforms), with emphasis on industry focused programs while solidly collaborating across key GTM stakeholders.
  • Own key business and revenue metrics across the sales funnel (pipeline) and customer growth and retention.

  • Partner with EMEA demand generation and product marketing to refine our targeting and segmentation, and to identify, scope, and produce or localize compelling content, marketing assets and programs to drive demand.
  • Define and execute full funnel UK marketing plans including digital marketing, demand generation campaigns, sales prospecting programs and ABM, executive engagement, virtual and in-person field events, and third party tradeshows and conferences as well as amplifying Stripe brand with users’ voices though case study production.
  • Track, measure, and communicate program results, continually optimize for efficiency and scale, and seek to generate new global best practices through experimental efforts.

  • Proven track record of defining and executing B2B marketing strategies that deliver against funnel metrics and KPIs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including being able to convey complex topics with simplicity.

descriptions.job-0kkfnw5:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Payments Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who lead and advise on opportunities for some of the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. We work alongside Stripe’s Core Sales and Customer Success teams to help users adopt products that improve their payment experiences, support international growth, and create new sources of revenue.

We are hiring an Account Executive, Product - Buy Now Pay Later to grow adoption of Klarna and Affirm among Stripe users across APAC. Based in Australia, this role will have an initial emphasis on Australia and other priority APAC markets. The Account Executive will primarily lead customer-facing sales motions and will also work with Stripe’s Partnerships team and our BNPL partners on strategic three-party opportunities.

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive, Product focused on Buy Now Pay Later, you will be a quota-carrying product-sales overlay responsible for growing adoption and payment volume across new and existing Stripe users. You will partner closely with Core Account Executives and Customer Success Managers throughout the sales cycle—from identifying and qualifying opportunities through commercial negotiation, technical validation, implementation, activation, and expansion.

You will develop deep expertise in Klarna, Affirm, the BNPL market, and the needs of users operating across APAC. You will lead business and technical conversations with stakeholders ranging from product and engineering teams to C-level executives, helping users understand how BNPL can support their customer experience and growth objectives. For strategic opportunities, you will coordinate across the user, Stripe, and the BNPL provider to align commercial terms, implementation plans, and launch requirements.

You are an adept salesperson who can build value in complex and competitive situations. You are comfortable navigating technical product discussions, complex customer organizations, and multi-party negotiations. You are equally effective with users and internal stakeholders, and you enjoy turning early customer signals into repeatable go-to-market motions.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver against an individual quota by driving adoption and payment volume for Klarna, Affirm and new potential BNPL partners across new and existing Stripe users in APAC.
  • Partner with Core Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to identify, qualify, develop, and close high-potential BNPL opportunities.
  • Build territory and account strategies that reflect user needs and payment preferences across Australia and other priority APAC markets.
  • Lead discovery with business, product, finance, and technical stakeholders and articulate a clear value proposition for BNPL adoption.
  • Develop customer-specific business cases that connect BNPL to user growth, customer experience, conversion, and global expansion objectives.
  • Navigate complex sales cycles and lead negotiations involving users, Stripe, and BNPL partners, working closely with Partnerships on commercial structure and partner alignment.
  • Coordinate with Solutions Architecture, Product, Engineering, and Post-Sales teams to translate user requirements into viable solutions and help users progress from decision to implementation and activation.
  • Maintain senior relationships with users and develop productive working relationships with Klarna, Affirm and new potential BNPL partners.
  • Monitor adoption and payment volume after launch, identify expansion opportunities, and work with account teams to address barriers to growth.
  • Serve as an internal and customer-facing BNPL expert, creating enablement and repeatable sales plays that improve the effectiveness of Stripe’s broader field organization.
  • Synthesize market intelligence and user feedback for Product, Engineering, Partnerships, and Marketing to help inform product and go-to-market priorities.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in sales, business development, partnerships, or a closely related commercial role at a technology company, with a track record of strong performance against goals.
  • Experience leading complex B2B sales cycles involving multiple business, commercial, and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to understand technical product requirements and translate them into clear customer outcomes and commercially viable solutions.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with product and engineering teams, operational leaders, and C-level executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Experience developing business cases and negotiating bespoke or multi-party commercial agreements.
  • A self-starting, highly organized approach and the ability to deliver results in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and analytical skills.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 10% of the time for user meetings, team events, sales kickoffs, and occasional international business needs.

Preferred qualifications

descriptions.job-140ig8l:
About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Role

AI agents are already booking travel, subscribing to software, running procurement end to end, and moving money on behalf of users — much of it through Rain. Our Agent Control Layer is the governing surface for that activity: it enforces approved counterparties, amounts, merchants, and task scope at initiation, before a transaction ever occurs, rather than reconciling damage after the fact.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own that platform. This is a 0-to-1 role inside a category being defined in real time. You will own the developer-facing surface — APIs, SDKs, controls, docs — that teams building agents use to give them spending power safely. McKinsey projects $3–$5 trillion in global agentic commerce by 2030. The primitives that make it trustworthy have not been built yet. You will build them.

You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with engineering, risk and compliance, network partnerships, and the developers shipping on us.

What you'll do

  • Define the primitives for agent authority: spend scopes, merchant and counterparty allowlists, velocity and amount ceilings, task-bound credentials, human-in-the-loop approvals, and clean revocation.
  • Own scoped virtual cards for agents — cards provisioned for a single merchant, amount, and task, retired the moment the task completes.
  • Extend the rest of Rain's stack (wallets, virtual accounts, onramps, offramps, cross-border payments) to agent initiators within the parameters our customers define.
  • Treat the API as the product. Own endpoint design, error semantics, idempotency, webhooks, sandbox and simulation tooling, SDKs, and reference agents.
  • Own documentation and the onboarding path with the same rigor as the product itself. Time-to-first-authorized-agent-transaction is your metric.
  • Run a tight design-partner loop with agent builders — read their integration code, sit in their debugging sessions, ship against what you find.
  • Build the roadmap from first principles: form a thesis on where agentic commerce goes next, sequence bets accordingly, and kill what isn't working quickly.
  • Partner with risk and compliance on Know Your Agent — agent identity, attestation, delegated authority, auditability, and dispute handling in a world where the cardholder wasn't the one who clicked.
  • Represent Rain's technical point of view in Agentic Payments Alliance working groups and with Visa, Mastercard, and stablecoin partners as standards take shape.
  • Write the specs, launch posts, and positioning that teach the market what controlled agentic payments actually means.

You’ll likely succeed if you have

  • 8+ years in product management, with meaningful time on a developer-facing platform, API, or infrastructure product. You have shipped something engineers chose to build on.
  • Technical depth. You read API diffs, write your own queries, prototype against your own endpoints, and hold your own in an architecture review. You don't need to have been an engineer; you do need engineers to take you seriously.
  • 0-to-1 instincts. You have taken a product from a blank page to real usage in an ambiguous market, and you're comfortable with a roadmap that changes because the ground moved.
  • Payments or fintech fluency, or the obvious appetite to acquire it fast. Authorization flows, issuing, interchange, chargebacks, settlement, KYC/KYB - you know these, or you'll learn them in weeks rather than quarters.
  • Judgment under risk. Every control you design trades capability against loss. You can reason about that tradeoff explicitly and defend where you landed.
  • Strong writing. At Rain, specs, docs, and launch narratives are the job, not overhead.
  • Bias for motion. You would rather ship a narrow thing this month and learn from it than scope a broad thing for two quarters.

Bonus attributes

  • Hands-on experience building or deploying AI agents - tool use, orchestration frameworks, MCP, evals.
  • Stablecoin or onchain payments background: settlement, custody, treasury operations, or wallet infrastructure.
  • Experience working directly with card networks, issuing processors, or sponsor banks.
  • Time at an early-stage company during a period of fast scaling.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters.

What you will be responsible for:

· Manage end-to-end purchase order and order tracking activities, including PO issuance and follow-up, production schedules, shipment timelines and delivery exceptions across suppliers in Asia.

· Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments via sea, air and land freight, including freight booking, customs clearance and import/export documentation.

· Ensure shipments comply with applicable import/export and trade requirements across relevant jurisdictions, including HS code classification, permits, licenses and duty requirements.

· Liaise with freight forwarders, customs brokers and logistics service providers to coordinate shipments, resolve operational issues and optimize lead times, freight costs and service levels.

· Maintain accurate shipment tracking and in-transit inventory visibility, proactively identifying and escalating delays, delivery risks and exceptions.

· Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including warehouse, finance, engineering and data center operations teams, to align procurement and delivery schedules with project requirements.

· Support the evaluation and management of freight forwarders and logistics service providers, including service performance reviews and rate negotiations.

· Maintain complete and audit-ready procurement, order and logistics documentation and records.

· Prepare regular management reports covering order status, shipment KPIs, procurement data, delivery performance, delays and key risks.

How you will stand out:

· Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, International Trade, Business or a related field.

· 1–3 years of relevant experience in procurement, logistics, order management or import/export operations, preferably covering cross-border activities in Asia.

· Familiarity with import/export regulations, customs procedures and trade compliance requirements. Experience with Singapore and Malaysia is preferred, while exposure to other Asian markets is an advantage.

· Hands-on experience managing purchase orders and tracking shipments end-to-end, from order placement through customs clearance to final delivery.

· Good working knowledge of Incoterms, HS code classification and customs/trade documentation.

· Experience with ERP, procurement or order/logistics tracking systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle) is an advantage.

· Strong attention to detail and organization, with good follow-through in managing multi-step, cross-border processes.

· Good written and verbal communication skills

· Strong coordination and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and respond to time-sensitive logistics issues.

· Proactive, resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What you will experience working with us:

  • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
  • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
  • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
  • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
  • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
  • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

--------------------------------------------------------------------

Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, colour, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.
